answer: According to Section 310(6) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, anyone belonging to a gang that habitually commits dacoity can be punished with imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment for a term that may extend to ten years, along with a fine. Additionally, if during the commission of dacoity, murder is committed by any one of five or more persons involved, all of them can face the death penalty, life imprisonment, or rigorous imprisonment for a minimum of ten years, also with fines (Section 310(3)).
summary_answer: The punishment for dacoity can include imprisonment for life, rigorous imprisonment for up to ten years, and fines.
detailed_answer: According to Section 310(6) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, anyone belonging to a gang that habitually commits dacoity can be punished with imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment for a term that may extend to ten years, along with a fine. Additionally, if during the commission of dacoity, murder is committed by any one of five or more persons involved, all of them can face the death penalty, life imprisonment, or rigorous imprisonment for a minimum of ten years, also with fines (Section 310(3)).
final_answer: The punishment for dacoity includes imprisonment for life, rigorous imprisonment for a term that may extend to ten years, and fines. In cases involving murder during dacoity, the punishment can escalate to death or life imprisonment.
